scope: Focused compiler-emission-gate follow-up; static active source plus one CPU-only SDK getter; no device allocation or compilation by this investigator.

active_source.status: Active installed cleartext source, distinct from readable core_ori backup.

confirmed_facts.claim: The active frontend creates weight-free meta constants only when UnitInfo.weight_free_mode differs from off and use_weight_sharing is true. Scalar tensors are excluded from this branch.
That branch creates a TVM meta array from the original tensor data pointer, records its pointer-to-name mapping with rebel.set_meta_key_name, and retains the tensor in a contiguous-weight cache.
Parameter conversion discovers prim::GetAttr graph nodes and obtains their tensors from state_dict before invoking the meta-constant branch.
The frontend from_pytorch API defaults use_weight_sharing to false and passes that value to convert_params.
With RBLN_WEIGHT_FREE absent, a normal active host SDK import reports rebel-compiler 0.11.0 and rebel.get_weight_free_mode() returns off. No runtime or model was allocated.
confirmed_facts.observation: CPU-only getter performed by this investigator.

independent_active_confirmation.claim: The companion investigator observed the same active SDK getter returning on when RBLN_WEIGHT_FREE=1 was supplied before import.
independent_active_confirmation.source: Companion active API investigation; not a device result.

inferences.claim: Dynamo/AOT lifting of parameters into graph inputs can explain empty meta-load names and transform groups, because such inputs do not traverse the attribute-constant conversion branch. The captured FX graph was not inspected here, so this is not a proven explanation for every backend graph.
An original nn.Module traced with attribute constants, weight sharing enabled, and weight-free mode on is the supported candidate compilation shape for emitting these metadata.

backup_only_context.claim: Readable backup selects intmd_mode separately from weight_mode; _intmd_mode=gen alone is not evidence that the active frontend weight-free gate is enabled.

configuration_conclusion: Enable RBLN_WEIGHT_FREE=1 before active SDK configuration and retain original module attribute weights with use_weight_sharing enabled. Check actual metadata and transform groups after compilation; is_eager_mode or _intmd_mode=gen alone does not establish metadata emission.
remaining_unknowns: Exact captured graph structure for the earlier zero-metadata Dynamo probes was not inspected.
All device compilation, output correctness, performance and allocation outcomes belong to the separate hardware report.
